ClientResponses.Response: Hi Jan, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We are so sorry to hear that your grill is not reaching desired temperatures after replacing the burner tubes. Your grill could be stuck on a bypass safety mode. What this does is reduce the heating in your grill. We are glad to see that our support team is assisting you with this! Please continue to work with our support team. If following the troubleshooting steps does not help, they can guide you in the right direction. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText: I at 79 years old have had many propane grills. The previous grill I replaced was a so called "true infrared" and was a curse. The small holes in the "stainless diffuser" plates always clogged and never worked good. This new Weber is amazing. I grilled two salmon filets, 4 burgers and some ""Kalby" yesterday and they came outstanding. You can get the heat up to 500 degrees quickly and the salmon never sticks to the grates. Webers cost a little more, but the quality and ruggedness make them well worth while.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
